ISS-oracle-ipv6-ssrf.title: SSRF guard misses bracketed IPv6 literals
ISS-oracle-ipv6-ssrf.summary: validateSourceURL/hostBlocked fails to recognize bracketed IPv6 URL hosts: net.ParseIP("[::1]") is nil (brackets not accepted), so [::1], [fc00::1], [fe80::1] fall through to DNS lookup, which fails -> reported NOT blocked on every host. All IPv6-literal SSRF vectors bypass the guard.

ISS-http-probe-panic.title: http loopback probe panics instead of skipping
ISS-http-probe-panic.summary: loopbackReachable() calls httptest.NewServer which panics ("listen tcp6 [::1]:0: socket: operation not permitted") in environments that deny loopback bind, so TestMain crashes instead of gracefully setting loopbackBlocked=true. Contradicts decision-http-tests-env-skip (just test green on this host).
